entities.summary: Eddy Anthony Curry Jr. is an American former professional basketball player. A 7 ft 0 in center, he came directly out of Thornwood High School in South Holland, Illinois, and was selected fourth overall in the 2001 NBA draft by the Chicago Bulls. Curry played for the Bulls until 2005, then played for the New York Knicks from 2005 to 2010. He played for the Miami Heat in the 2011–12 season and was part of the Heat's 2012 championship team. He played for the Dallas Mavericks for the early part of the 2012–13 season before playing out the season for the Zhejiang Golden Bulls of the Chinese Basketball Association.
